title: Cascading Adversarial Bias from Injection to Distillation in Language Models
reasoning: The paper focuses on the technical mechanisms of adversarial bias injection and its amplification during model distillation. While it mentions safety-related metrics like toxicity and 'honesty' (measuring hurtful completions) as part of its defensive evaluation, the core research focuses on commercial (advertisements) and security (phishing, code) biases rather than the evaluation of religious beliefs, theology, or ethical/moral frameworks.
